summary: A form field for picking a color, showing a swatch you click to open a color picker.
description:
A labeled color swatch input backed by a native <input type="color">, used to pick a CSS color value.

**`MozInputColor extends MozLitElement`,** not MozBaseInputElement, and declares only `value`, `name` and `label`. So it inherits none of the input family's shared members: the three attributes below are the whole surface.

**Figma offers a `disabled` state this element does not have.** `color-picker.figma.ts` emits `disabled=${props.disabled}` onto `<moz-input-color>`, and `disabled` appears nowhere in moz-input-color.mjs or its CSS, so that attribute is inert.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A CSS hex value shown in the swatch area.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name associated with the nested native input element; useful in forms.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text of the label shown next to the swatch.

events.name: change
events.description: Redispatched from the native input's change event when the user commits a new color value (this.value is updated first, then the change event is re-fired from the host so it crosses the shadow boundary).
